findings.evidence: A good clear photo of nobody's mother looking at nothing.
findings.diagnosis: Collapses the scene's meaning into a paradoxical epigram, stating the theme (erasure/absence) as a bon mot instead of dramatizing it — the aphoristic, sententious close the profile warns against.

findings.evidence: Time was the officer standing up.
findings.diagnosis: The 'X was Y' inversion front-loads the abstraction 'Time' for effect, against 'practical word before the felt one'.

findings.evidence: The stamp gone to nothing on her hand.
findings.diagnosis: 'gone to nothing' blurs the invisible-ink detail and pre-echoes 'looking at nothing', making the later epigram feel contrived.
